_about: CEO 29.10 (trips abroad, wave 1, server only): fuel prices, tolls, fees, documents and rules per country, copied from docs/plan/abroad-wave1-sources.md. Nothing here is a new figure: each value has the URL and the source type the sources doc gives.
Every fact was read from the text of search results on 2026-10-29, not from the opened page (sources doc §0): the engine marks all of it «не проверено».
Source types (sources doc §0): official = a state body, regulator or toll operator; primary = media quoting an official decision; secondary = blogs, insurers, aggregators.
Fuel: `values` is one price or a [lowest, highest] pair from the source; the engine budgets the highest. A fuel without a price here (AB, AM, TR ai92) is unknown, never a guess.

Fees: a fee is counted in the trip's money only when its amount comes from an official or primary source, it is mandatory, unconditional and not contradicted (`conflict`). Otherwise it is shown with «по данным …» and not counted (sources doc §12).
`variants`: a fee per period; the engine takes the shortest period that covers the trip's days and says which one.
